svg.title: The same settings, suite by suite
svg.text: The same settings, suite by suite
Each suite on its own scale, one panel per provider, with the best-value effort each suite finds.
Best-value effort: the last step costing at most 40% more per point
One line per model, joining its efforts from lowest to highest. A dash pattern tells one provider's models apart. The marker's shape names the effort. Data read 2026-11-19.
